status_stock_out.te: Gamaninchandi: shop lo biyyam aipoyindi, booking aagipoyindi.
status_stock_out.hi: Dhyan dijiye: dukaan mein chawal khatam hai, booking ruki hai.
status_stock_out.en: Please note: the shop is out of rice and booking is paused.

status_machine_down.te: Gamaninchandi: shop lo machine pani cheyyatledu, booking aagipoyindi.
status_machine_down.hi: Dhyan dijiye: dukaan ki machine band hai, booking ruki hai.
status_machine_down.en: Please note: the shop's machine is down and booking is paused.

confirm_card.hi: Card ke aakhri ank {last4}, theek hai?

which_card.te: Mee phone ki {count} cardlu unnayi: {options}. Ye card? Chivari ankelu cheppandi.
which_card.hi: Aapke phone par {count} card hain: {options}. Kaun sa? Aakhri ank boliye.
which_card.en: Your phone has {count} cards: {options}. Which one? Say the last digits.

ask_card_digits.te: Mee ration card number okko anke cheppandi.
ask_card_digits.hi: Apna ration card number ek ek ank karke boliye.
ask_card_digits.en: Please say your ration card number, digit by digit.

card_not_found.te: Ee number tho card dorakaledu. Malli cheppandi.
card_not_found.hi: Is number ka card nahi mila. Phir se boliye.
card_not_found.en: No card found with that number. Please say it again.

card_linked.te: Sare, card {last4} ee phone ki link chesamu.
card_linked.hi: Theek hai, card {last4} is phone se jod diya.
card_linked.en: Done, card {last4} is now linked to this phone.

stock_yes.te: Avunu, biyyam vachindi. Mee kutumbaniki {kg} kilolu.
stock_yes.hi: Haan, chawal aa gaya hai. Aapke parivaar ke liye {kg} kilo.
stock_yes.en: Yes, rice has come. {kg} kg for your family.

stock_no.te: Ledu, biyyam inka raaledu. Mee kutumbaniki {kg} kilolu raavali.
stock_no.hi: Nahi, chawal abhi nahi aaya. Aapke parivaar ke liye {kg} kilo milega.
stock_no.en: No, rice has not come yet. {kg} kg is due for your family.

queue_empty.hi: Abhi line nahi hai, seedhe aa jaiye.
queue_empty.en: There is no queue right now, come straight in.

booked.te: Booking ayindi. Mee token {token}. {via} lo pampamu.
booked.hi: Booking ho gayi. Aapka token {token}. {via} par bheja hai.
booked.en: Booked. Your token is {token}. Sent by {via}.

booking_refused_month.te: Ee nela mee card ki booking already undi: {day} {time}, token {token}.
booking_refused_month.hi: Is mahine aapke card ki booking pehle se hai: {day} {time}, token {token}.
booking_refused_month.en: Your card already has a booking this month: {day} {time}, token {token}.

booking_paused.te: Ippudu booking aagipoyindi. Line lo vachi teesukovachu.
booking_paused.hi: Abhi booking ruki hai. Aap line mein aa sakte hain.
booking_paused.en: Booking is paused right now. You can still come and join the line.

no_slots.te: {day} {session} lo khaali slot ledu. Vere roju leka vere samayam cheppandi.
no_slots.hi: {day} {session} koi khaali slot nahi hai. Doosra din ya samay boliye.
no_slots.en: No free slot {day} {session}. Please say another day or time.

ask_other.te: Vere roju leka vere samayam cheppandi.
ask_other.en: Please say another day or time.

ask_kg.en: How many kilos did you get?

complaint_filed.te: Complaint namodu chesamu. Number {complaint_no}. Vaaram lopala chustamu.
complaint_filed.hi: Shikayat darj ho gayi. Number {complaint_no}. Ek hafte mein dekhenge.
complaint_filed.en: Complaint filed. Number {complaint_no}. It will be looked at within a week.

complaint_none.te: Meeku {due} kilolu raavali, {kg} kilolu vachayi. Idi sarigaane undi.
complaint_none.hi: Aapko {due} kilo milna tha, {kg} kilo mila. Yeh sahi hai.
complaint_none.en: {due} kg was due and you got {kg} kg. That is the full amount.

sorry.te: Kshaminchandi, ardham kaaledu. Dayachesi malli cheppandi.
sorry.hi: Maaf kijiye, samajh nahi aaya. Kripya phir se boliye.
sorry.en: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Please say it again.

menu.te: Stock kosam 1, line kosam 2, booking kosam 3, takkuva ration kosam 4 nokkandi.
menu.hi: Stock ke liye 1, line ke liye 2, booking ke liye 3, kam ration ke liye 4 dabaiye.
menu.en: Press 1 for stock, 2 for queue, 3 to book, 4 to report short ration.

menu_text.te: Number pampandi: 1 Stock, 2 Line, 3 Booking, 4 Takkuva ration.
menu_text.hi: Number bhejiye: 1 Stock, 2 Line, 3 Booking, 4 Kam ration.
menu_text.en: Reply with a number: 1 Stock, 2 Queue, 3 Book, 4 Short ration.

silence.hi: Kya aap sun rahe hain? Kripya boliye.
silence.en: Are you there? Please say something.

goodbye.en: Thank you. Call again any time.

language_switched.hi: Theek hai, ab main Hindi mein baat karungi.
language_switched.en: Okay, I will speak English now.

reminder.te: Ration Bolo: bayaluderandi, mee slot {time} ki. Mundu {ahead} mandi unnaru.
reminder.hi: Ration Bolo: nikal padiye, aapka slot {time} baje hai. Aage {ahead} log hain.
reminder.en: Ration Bolo: leave now, your slot is at {time}. {ahead} are ahead.

code_sent.te: Dhruveekarana kosam ee phone ki 4 ankela code SMS lo pampamu. Code cheppandi, leka vaddu ante 'kaadu' ani cheppandi.
code_sent.hi: Pushti ke liye is phone par 4 ank ka code SMS se bheja hai. Code boliye, ya chhodne ke liye 'nahi' boliye.
code_sent.en: To verify, we sent a 4-digit code to this phone by SMS. Say the code, or say no to skip.

code_ok.hi: Dhanyavaad, aapka phone pramanit ho gaya.
code_ok.en: Thank you, your phone is verified.

code_wrong.hi: Code galat hai. Phir se boliye.
code_wrong.en: That code is not right. Please say it again.

sms_code.hi: Ration Bolo code: {code}. Kisi ko na batayein.
sms_code.en: Ration Bolo code: {code}. Do not share it.

no_booking_level0.te: Ee shop lo inka booking ledu.
no_booking_level0.hi: Is dukaan mein abhi booking nahi hoti.
no_booking_level0.en: This shop doesn't take bookings yet.

best_time_usual.hi: Aam taur par {day} {time} ke baad bheed kam hoti hai.

best_time_known.hi: {day} {time} ke baad aam taur par {minutes} minute se kam.

no_recent_reports.te: Mee shop gurinchi ippudu kotta samacharam ledu.
no_recent_reports.hi: Aapki dukaan ki abhi koi taaza jaankari nahi hai.
no_recent_reports.en: No recent reports for your shop.

level_dropped_booking.te: Shop ippudu bookings nirdharinchadam ledu; mee {time} samayam ippatiki rush takkuva samayame.
level_dropped_booking.hi: Dukaan ab booking pakki nahi karti; aapka {time} ka samay ab bhi kam bheed wala hai.
level_dropped_booking.en: The shop no longer confirms bookings; your {time} time is still a quiet time to go.

report_only_at_shop.te: Shop daggara unnappude report cheyyandi. Dhanyavaadalu.
report_only_at_shop.hi: Dukaan par hone par hi report kijiye. Dhanyavaad.
report_only_at_shop.en: Please report only when you are at the shop. Thank you.

report_readback.hi: Aap bata rahe hain: {items}, theek hai?

report_saved.hi: Dhanyavaad, aapki report darj ho gayi.
report_saved.en: Thank you, your report is saved.

status_from_reports.hi: {what}, pichhle {minutes} minute mein {count} logon ne bataya.
status_from_reports.en: {what}, confirmed by {count} people in the last {minutes} minutes.

status_one_report.hi: {what}: {minutes} minute pehle ek vyakti ne bataya.
status_one_report.en: {what}: one person reported it {minutes} minutes ago.

queue_reported.te: Cardholders cheppina prakaram sumaru {ahead} mandi unnaru, sumaru {minutes} nimishalu.
queue_reported.hi: Logon ki report ke hisaab se lagbhag {ahead} log hain, lagbhag {minutes} minute.
queue_reported.en: By cardholders' reports about {ahead} people are there, about {minutes} minutes.

checkin_saved.te: Meeru shop daggara unnaru ani namodu chesamu. Gata gantalo {count} mandi check-in chesaru.
checkin_saved.hi: Aap dukaan par hain, darj kar liya. Pichhle ghante mein {count} log check-in kar chuke hain.
checkin_saved.en: Noted that you are at the shop. {count} people checked in in the last hour.

public_started.te: Public ammakala data prakaram shop {time} ki ammakalu modalupettindi.
public_started.hi: Sarkari bikri data ke anusaar dukaan ne {time} baje bikri shuru ki.
public_started.en: Public sales data shows the shop started selling at {time}.

public_stopped.te: Public ammakala data lo {minutes} nimishaluga ammakalu levu; shop aagi undavachu.
public_stopped.hi: Sarkari bikri data mein {minutes} minute se koi bikri nahi; dukaan ruki ho sakti hai.
public_stopped.en: Public sales data shows no sales for {minutes} minutes; the shop may have stopped.

nearby_offer.te: Shop {code}, {landmark}, {km} km dooram lo undi; akkada biyyam undi, sumaru {minutes} nimishala wait.
nearby_offer.hi: Dukaan {code}, {landmark}, {km} km door hai; wahan chawal hai, lagbhag {minutes} minute ka intezaar.
nearby_offer.en: Shop {code}, {landmark}, {km} km away, has rice and about {minutes} minutes' wait.

nearby_offer_plain.te: Shop {code}, {landmark}, {km} km dooram lo undi; sumaru {minutes} nimishala wait.
nearby_offer_plain.hi: Dukaan {code}, {landmark}, {km} km door hai; lagbhag {minutes} minute ka intezaar.
nearby_offer_plain.en: Shop {code}, {landmark}, {km} km away, about {minutes} minutes' wait.

nearby_ask.te: One Nation One Ration Card tho sadharananga akkada kuda mee ration teesukovachu. Akkadiki veltara?
nearby_ask.hi: One Nation One Ration Card se aam taur par aap wahan bhi ration le sakte hain. Wahan jaayenge?
nearby_ask.en: Under One Nation One Ration Card you can usually collect your ration there too. Want to go there?

grievance_sent.te: Adhikarulaku file cheyyadaniki complaint text {via} lo pampamu.
grievance_sent.hi: Adhikariyon ke paas darj karne ke liye shikayat ka text {via} par bheja hai.
grievance_sent.en: We sent the complaint text by {via} to file with the officials.

helpline_offer.te: Ippude state food helpline ki connect cheyyamantara?
helpline_offer.hi: Kya abhi state food helpline se jod doon?
helpline_offer.en: Shall I connect you to the state food helpline now?

helpline_connecting.te: Helpline ki connect chestunnamu. Mee complaint number {complaint_no}.
helpline_connecting.hi: Helpline se jod rahe hain. Aapka shikayat number {complaint_no}.
helpline_connecting.en: Connecting you to the helpline. Your complaint number is {complaint_no}.

ask_reference.en: Please say the reference number you were given.

reference_saved.te: Reference number ni complaint {complaint_no} tho namodu chesamu.
reference_saved.hi: Reference number shikayat {complaint_no} ke saath darj kar liya.
reference_saved.en: Saved the reference number with complaint {complaint_no}.

no_open_complaint.te: Mee card ki open complaint ledu.
no_open_complaint.hi: Aapke card par koi khuli shikayat nahi hai.
no_open_complaint.en: Your card has no open complaint.

grievance_formal.te: Complaint {complaint_no}: Fair Price Shop {shop} ({area}) lo {date} na card chivari ankelu {last4} ki {due} kilolu raavalsindi, {kg} kilolu matrame ichharu. Jaateeya Aahaara Bhadrata Chattam 2013 (Sections 14, 15) prakaram vicharinchi poorti ration ivvagalaru.
grievance_formal.hi: Shikayat {complaint_no}: Fair Price Shop {shop} ({area}) par {date} ko card ke aakhri ank {last4} ko {due} kilo ke badle sirf {kg} kilo mila. Rashtriya Khadya Suraksha Adhiniyam 2013 (dhara 14, 15) ke tahat jaanch kar poora ration dilaayein.
grievance_formal.en: Complaint {complaint_no}: at Fair Price Shop {shop} ({area}) on {date}, card ending {last4} received {kg} kg against {due} kg due. Under the National Food Security Act, 2013 (Sections 14 and 15: grievance redressal), please inquire and ensure the full entitlement.

grievance_steps.te: File cheyyadaniki: {state_portal} leka {national_portal}. Complaint {complaint_no} ani cheppandi.
grievance_steps.hi: Darj karne ke liye: {state_portal} ya {national_portal}. Shikayat {complaint_no} bataiye.
grievance_steps.en: To file it: {state_portal} or {national_portal}. Quote complaint {complaint_no}.

escalate_district.te: Ration Bolo: complaint {complaint_no} 7 rojulaina parishkarinchaledu. District grievance officer ki escalate cheyyandi: {district}. Vaallu ichhina reference number maaku call chesi cheppandi.
escalate_district.hi: Ration Bolo: shikayat {complaint_no} 7 din mein hal nahi hui. District grievance officer ke paas le jaiye: {district}. Unka reference number humein call karke bataiye.
escalate_district.en: Ration Bolo: complaint {complaint_no} is not resolved after 7 days. Escalate it to the District Grievance Redressal Officer: {district}. Call us and say the reference number they give you.

escalate_national.te: Ration Bolo: complaint {complaint_no} 21 rojulaina open lo undi. Jaateeya public grievance portal {national_portal} lo kinda text tho file cheyyandi.
escalate_national.hi: Ration Bolo: shikayat {complaint_no} 21 din baad bhi khuli hai. Rashtriya public grievance portal {national_portal} par neeche diye text ke saath darj kijiye.
escalate_national.en: Ration Bolo: complaint {complaint_no} is still open after 21 days. File it on the national public grievance portal {national_portal} with the text below.

district_unknown.hi: aapke District Supply Officer ka daftar

dealer_menu.te: Dealer menu: biyyam vachindi ante 1, biyyam aipoyindi ante 2, machine down ante 3, machine pani chestondi ante 4 nokkandi leka cheppandi.
dealer_menu.hi: Dealer menu: chawal aa gaya 1, chawal khatam 2, machine band 3, machine chalu 4 dabaiye ya boliye.
dealer_menu.en: Dealer menu: press 1 or say 'stock arrived', 2 'stock finished', 3 'machine down', 4 'machine working'.

dealer_again.hi: Aur koi badlaav ho to boliye.
dealer_again.en: Say or press another update, or hang up.

optin_saved.te: Sare, shop lo biyyam vachinappudu meeku cheptamu.
optin_saved.hi: Theek hai, dukaan mein chawal aane par aapko batayenge.
optin_saved.en: Okay, we will tell you when rice arrives at your shop.

optout_saved.hi: Theek hai, ab chawal ki suchna nahi bhejenge.
optout_saved.en: Okay, we will stop rice arrival messages.

broadcast_rice_arrived.te: Ration Bolo: mee shop {shop} lo biyyam vachindi.
broadcast_rice_arrived.hi: Ration Bolo: aapki dukaan {shop} mein chawal aa gaya hai.
broadcast_rice_arrived.en: Ration Bolo: rice has arrived at your shop {shop}.

public_not_started.te: Public ammakala data prakaram ivala inka ammakalu modalukaledu.
public_not_started.hi: Sarkari bikri data ke anusaar aaj abhi bikri shuru nahi hui.
public_not_started.en: Public sales data shows no sales yet today.

public_closed.te: Ivala {total} ammakalu ayyayi; shop ippudu moosi undi, {opens} terustaru.
public_closed.hi: Aaj {total} bikri hui; dukaan abhi band hai, {opens} khulegi.
public_closed.en: {total} sales today; the shop is closed now and opens {opens}.

basis.en: National Food Security Act, 2013, Sections 14 and 15
